page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, configured with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via hyper-threading. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including PassMark CPU and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, achieve average mid-tier results. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate average throughput for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks, though the overall PassMark memory score remains in the lower 25% bracket.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core throughput, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate multi-threaded compilation tasks. It also supports light LLM inference tasks for smaller models, though text generation speeds are limited by the weaker single-core performance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a stable, dedicated resource profile for enterprise applications that require consistent multi-core processing without the premium cost of high-frequency compute-optimized or memory-heavy configurations.
